The attempts file is written by the separate Record step, which is not continue-on-error.

Advisory by design (CLAUDE.md rule 19): a lost write leaves yesterday's snapshot, which the morning email shows as 'not checked yet' (renderPressNightBlock night check) and digest-snapshots.js flags past 36h, so a failure is visible without failing the checklist job.

BRO-6038 shadow mode: the step writes a counts-only report that the digest row reads; a failed run leaves no file and the digest shows an undetermined row, never a pass. It does not gate anything while in shadow.
